questions.q: A man has normal serum testosterone but markedly reduced intratesticular testosterone after selective Leydig-cell dysfunction. Which process is most directly compromised?
options: Secretion of inhibin by Sertoli cells only
questions.explain: Leydig cells produce testosterone, which reaches high intratesticular concentrations and is essential for normal spermatogenesis. Normal circulating testosterone does not necessarily ensure adequate intratesticular levels.

questions.q: Which pituitary hormone acts directly on Leydig cells to stimulate testosterone synthesis?
questions.explain: Luteinising hormone (LH) stimulates Leydig cells to synthesise testosterone. FSH acts mainly on Sertoli cells, supporting spermatogenesis and stimulating inhibin B production.
